headline: FOOD and CONS dominate unusual-trading alerts, with EMC and TRITN collapsing while KBS, TC and MII post extreme volume spikes
market_take: Coverage saw broad weakness at the small-cap end, led by EMC -50.00% on thin trade and TRITN -33.33% on a -33.33% open gap. Mid-cap REITs/property names were softer (AWC -5.03%, J -3.80%, ESTAR -4.00%) while PF -20.00% was flagged alongside two debentureholders' meeting filings. Blue-chip CONMAT was constructive (SCC +3.31%). Alert activity was heavy in FOOD/CONS (10 of 20 high alerts) and tied to several pending SET clarifications and rehabilitation/management filings.

sector_notes.note: Heavy alert cluster: AQUA -9.09%, XBIO -16.67% gap then +20.00% intraday reversal, KBS 5.0σ volume spike; TKN had multiple share repurchase filings (Oct 1, 2, 5, 6) and OKJ filed a clarification on the trading alert list (Oct 5).

Sharp downside: EMC -50.00% (vol×0.06) and TRITN -33.33% (vol×0.08) with matching open-gap/intraday alerts; PLE opened +16.67% then reversed -14.29%. TTCL filed a rehabilitation progress update (Oct 5) after a +33.3% 5-day run, and ITD notified the resignation of its President (Oct 2).

Mixed tone: AWC -5.03%, J -3.80%, ESTAR -4.00% outweighed PRECHA +4.17% and MK +3.92%; CGD opened +11.11% and closed -10.00%, RICHY opened -6.25% and closed +6.67%. STELLA flagged a 3.4σ volume spike and filed a progress-of-cases report (Oct 5); ASW disclosed acquisition of a subsidiary (Oct 6); LH declared an interim dividend (Oct 1).
MNRF +3.96% (vol×0.04, thin), CPNCG 3.5σ and MII 8.4σ volume spikes; ALLY notified a non-Thai nationality offering price update (Oct 2) and KTBSTMR notified REIT manager personnel changes (Oct 1).
SMO flagged a 6.4σ volume spike, the largest in the alert set, and filed a Chairman/Director resignation (Oct 1); TL filed a SET clarification on Q2/2026 financial statements (Oct 2).
SCC +3.31% on vol×1.12; EPG flagged a 4.9σ volume spike; DCON filed AGM progress on PRIN shareholder rights (Oct 2).
